answer: Lock a 25.000 POA bond per identity, then run a random spot-audit lottery: every epoch, 10% of identities are pulled for a surprise work audit, like checking random reef buoys instead of the whole trellis. An identity that fails, or is found fake, has its bond burned and is ejected for 6 epochs, and the audit trail stays a public thread anyone can replay. A farmer running 1.000 fake identities must lock 25.000 x 1.000 = 25.000.000 POA, while an honest agent locks 25.000 only once. Honest limitation: the fixed bond prices out honest newcomers with no starting capital.
